name: VIP-REACTION-CHATBOT
description: A high-speed Telegram auto-reaction and AI chatbot with custom emojis, group/channel support, and bot cloning by Amrit Raj (@Villanns).

MONGO_URL.description: Optional MongoDB connection URL (leave empty for in-memory DB)

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Free Groq API key for ultra-fast (0.3s) Angle AI chatbot

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional Google Gemini API key for smart AI answers

PORT.description: Port for web health check on Koyeb

KOYEB_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL of your Koyeb service for 24/7 automated keep-alive

STORAGE_THRESHOLD.description: Disk storage percentage threshold to trigger Telegram owner alert (default: 90)
